digest.component_or_area: metrics adapters — Claude Code transcript mining
propositions: An optional, isolated backfill adapter mines local Claude Code session transcripts to reconstruct env/integration-diagnosis history without depending on the core metrics command.
The adapter uses deterministic keyword/regex pattern matching (not LLM inference) to classify error signatures into the enum: env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none.
Every emitted record is labeled source=backfill_classified, confidence=classified to signal low-confidence backfill data and segregate it from authoritative structural metrics.
The core metrics package (registry.py, __init__.py) must not import the transcript adapter to maintain portability; this isolation is enforced by unit test scanning.

scripts/backfill_transcripts.py performs targeted error-signature grep over transcript JSONL, classifies candidate lines deterministically, and emits labeled classified interval records matching the schema.
The implementation is self-contained and reproducible—no model call or human calibration—so the adapter and test are fully testable in isolation.
